summary: Added a web-reference regression test for selecting a remote screen while temporary thumbnail capture is still running. The capture completion preserves the explicitly selected viewer subscription, matching Flutter's protected lifecycle behavior. Full frontend tests and production typecheck/build pass; paired runtime delivery remains unverified.
